title: Finding
description: Schema for an AWS Security Finding Format (ASFF) finding object used by Amazon Security Hub to normalize and aggregate security findings from multiple sources.

SchemaVersion.description: The schema version that the finding is formatted for.

ProductArn.description: The ARN generated by Security Hub for the product that generated the finding.

GeneratorId.description: The identifier for the solution-specific component that generated the finding.

AwsAccountId.description: The AWS account ID where the finding was generated.

Types.description: One or more finding types in the format of namespace/category/classifier.

CreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the finding was created.

UpdatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the finding was most recently updated.

Label.description: The severity label assigned to the finding.

Normalized.description: The normalized severity of the finding on a 0-100 scale.

Original.description: The native severity from the finding product.

Title.description: A finding title that summarizes the finding.

Description.description: A detailed description of the finding.

Text.description: Describes the recommended steps to take to remediate the finding.

Url.description: A URL that links to remediation information.

Resources.description: A set of resource data types describing the resources the finding refers to.

Id.description: The canonical identifier for the resource.

Tags.description: A list of AWS tags associated with the resource.

Details.description: Additional details about the resource related to the finding.

Status.description: The result of a standards check.

SecurityControlId.description: The unique identifier of a control across standards.

Workflow.description: Provides information about the status of the investigation into a finding.

Status.description: The status of the investigation into the finding.

RecordState.description: The record state of the finding.

ProductFields.description: A data type where security finding providers can include additional solution-specific details.

Confidence.description: A finding confidence score between 0 and 100.

Criticality.description: The level of importance assigned to the resources associated with the finding.
